maria: Quick sync after the postmortem docs. We still have ~1.2k invoices with token deltas due to the late-ingest window. Need a compact plan: who owns what, exact order of ops (so we avoid double credits), and a closure timeline.
kevin: I can own the reprocess & dedupe work. Root cause confirmed: a migration changed the join order and increased transient retries which backfilled late. Plan: add a dedupe hash at ingest and emit a processed_marker column. Owner: kevin. ETA: PR by Thu EOD. :white_check_mark:
sam: I can stand up a dedicated backfill worker pool (spot nodes) to avoid touching prod inference capacity. I need the account list + estimate of total token ops to size it. Estimate: 8 vCPUs & 16GB per worker, ~12 workers for ~4h if kevin's dedupe reduces noise.
maria: Olivia from billing-ops will you be primary for manual invoice corrections? We want a two-phase approach: automated credits for low-risk accounts, manual tickets for enterprise/legal ones.
olivia: Yes. I'll triage manual set and run approval path. Initial split looks like ~950 auto, ~250 manual (enterprise + disputed). I'll publish a CSV tomorrow with columns invoice_id, account_id, expected_tokens, observed_tokens, delta_tokens, auto_flag, enterprise_flag, reason_hint. Owner: olivia. ETA: tomorrow 09:30 PT.
natalie: I'll add a reconciliation-friendly export that includes ledger_sequence and billing_period to speed audits. Also adding a checksum column to validate post-credit totals.
raj: Monitoring action: add an ingest-canary that validates 1% of requests within 5m post-deploy and alerts on >30m lag. Also creating a Grafana panel for weekly deploy-adjacent spikes. Owner: raj. ETA: 48h.
kevin: SQL I used to enumerate candidate invoices (different than prior):
```sql
SELECT i.invoice_id, i.account_id, SUM(t.tokens) AS observed_tokens, i.expected_token_count
FROM invoices i
JOIN token_events t ON t.invoice_ref = i.invoice_id
WHERE t.processed_at > i.period_end + interval '30 minutes'
GROUP BY i.invoice_id, i.account_id, i.expected_token_count
HAVING ABS(SUM(t.tokens) - i.expected_token_count) > 10
ORDER BY ABS(SUM(t.tokens) - i.expected_token_count) DESC
LIMIT 1500;
```
kevin: Note: this query flags deltas > 10 tokens to avoid noise; adjust threshold if needed.
maria: Process order to avoid double-work: (1) land dedupe + processed_marker, (2) run backfill off-prod, (3) compute post-backfill diff and freeze auto_flag set, (4) apply auto credits with audit_tag=pm-2976543210, (5) create manual-adj tickets for flagged enterprise rows. Do not run credits before backfill completes.
kevin: I'll add a feature-flagged run mode and a PR playbook that includes stop/start checks. Will annotate ledger writes with memo=postmortem-2976543210 for traceability.
sam: Scheduling: target Sat 03:00 PT for backfill run (low traffic). If kevin lands PR Thu, I can provision infra Fri night and run a smoke test Fri 22:00 PT.
olivia: Manual ticket template: include invoice_id, delta_tokens, suggested_credit_amount, legal_flag, approver, created_by. I'll also attach an evidence slice.
natalie: For audit, I'll produce a per-invoice before/after snapshot CSV plus a manifest with checksums.
raj: I'll also wire an alert that posts to #eng-oncall with the first 10 affected account_ids when lag exceeds threshold.
maria: Owners recap: kevin (code + PR), sam (backfill infra + run), olivia (manual triage + tickets), natalie (audit exports), raj (monitoring). Timeline: olivia CSV tomorrow 09:30 PT, kevin PR Thu EOD, backfill Sat 03:00 PT, credits Mon 06:00 PT after verification.
